description: The Smarter Networks Portal of the Energy Networks Association is the register of innovation projects run by Great Britain's gas and electricity network companies. A project page read on 2026-09-26, for HyNTS FutureGrid Phase 1, shows the record structure: status, project reference, strategy theme, start and end dates, lead and funding licensees, funding mechanism (such as the Network Innovation Competition, Network Innovation Allowance or Strategic Innovation Fund), technology, expenditure, preceding projects, third party collaborators, and tabs for summary, learnings and documents. That project built a hydrogen test facility from decommissioned National Transmission System assets to test blends up to 100 percent hydrogen at NTS pressures, from April 2021 to December 2023 at a cost of about 12.7 million pounds. The portal covers projects themed by active networks, asset management, communications and IT, commercial, resilience and hydrogen, and offers search, events and innovation reports. Coverage is GB network operators. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): ENA site licence: download and print for internal business use; extracted content expected under CC BY-NC. Caveats: project pages are written by the funded companies and results sit in attached reports, not structured data. Simulation uses are evidence for hydrogen conversion and resilience planning of gas and power networks, and capacity planning of network innovation. Related records: data-national-gas-transmission-data-portal holds operational data of the National Transmission System, and model-blendpath-hydrogen-blending-pipeline-tool estimates blending costs.
